generate_build_files_bazel: run generate_build_files.py with bazel to produce BUILD.generated.bzl source lists
generate_build_files_cmake: run generate_build_files.py with cmake to produce CMakeLists.txt for BoringSSL
generate_build_files_gn: run generate_build_files.py with gn to produce BUILD.generated.gni source lists
generate_build_files_android: run generate_build_files.py with android to produce sources.bp and sources.mk
generate_build_files_json: run generate_build_files.py with json to produce sources.json source file listing
